label: real accepting reply, Opus 5.5, round 1, JSONL line 17
reply:
**No.** OpenZeppelin 5.x `ECDSA.recover` accepts only 65-byte signatures with low-`s` values (64-byte EIP-2098 compact signatures are rejected), and `v` values other than 27/28 fail to recover, so a user cannot turn a valid voucher into a second valid signature for the same digest.

Keying replay protection on the signature bytes is still fragile, though: if the signer ever signs the same `(msg.sender, amount)` twice, those vouchers can be redeemed again. A safer design puts a nonce or voucher ID in the signed struct and marks the digest or nonce as used.
